svg.text: System Block Diagram — CPU / Cache / SDRAM Controller
SDRAM DOUT [7:0] (fetched block -> write mux input 1)
CPU DIN [7:0] (read data <- read demux output 1)
CLK is shared by every block (omitted, as in the spec’s Figure 3). Data never enters the Cache Controller: the write mux and read demux route it, and the controller only drives their select lines.
